pages.text: The Paintbrush repaints the faces of sawmill blocks. Sneak and use it on the block you want to copy the face of: a sawmill block gives the face you clicked, any other block its own texture on that side.
pages.title: Paintbrush

pages.text: Then use it on a face of a sawmill block to paint it. Sneak and use it in the air to load a see-through face. On gates, sneaking paints instead of copying, since using a gate opens it. Each face painted uses up the brush a little.
